_doc: Units. side 'player' = yours (built at your Nodes and captured cities), 'native' = the homeworld factions' armies, 'structure' = a settlement's walls (not a real unit). speed = movement points per cycle; sight = vision radius; upow = base Unit Power (battle strength); energy = Energy allocated while the unit exists (never consumed). domain: 'land' walks, 'air' ignores terrain and crosses water, 'sea' sails water hexes. attack = can start fights; capture = can take an undefended city by moving in; oneShot = destroyed after its strike; requires = tech that unlocks it. side 'abyssian' = kaiju from the ocean rifts (M3): amphibious = walks on any water, kaiju = conventional units fight it at a penalty (rules.json abyss.kaijuHidePct; TBUs and hardened symbiotes ignore it), essence = Symbiotic Essence dropped when you kill it, from/weight = when and how often a rift spawns it. weapon = tracer style in the Watch. drawScale = map sprite scale (kaiju art is 128x128, the Mother 256x256). TBUs are not listed here: they are assembled from titans.json parts. Art: assets/art/unit_<id>_idle.png, 64x64 per frame (kaiju 128, Mother 256), 4 frames in one row.

units.name: Observer Drone
units.blurb: Recon. Flies over anything, sees far, cannot fight.

units.name: Sentinel Trooper
units.blurb: Android infantry. Takes cities.

units.name: Bastion Tank
units.blurb: Heavy armour. The backbone of a siege.

units.name: Tidewarden
units.blurb: Autonomous warship. Built at coastal settlements; shells anything next to the water.

units.name: Shrike Jet
units.blurb: Strike fighter. Fast, strong, cannot hold ground.

units.name: Lance Missile
units.blurb: One strike, then gone. Cracks garrisons.

units.name: Militia
units.blurb: Native infantry: rifles, courage, numbers.

units.name: Armored Column
units.blurb: Native tanks and APCs.

units.name: Gunship
units.blurb: Native attack helicopters.

units.name: Skitterling
units.blurb: A brood-runner the size of a truck. Not a kaiju: conventional arms can kill it.

units.name: Tidecrawler
units.blurb: A plated crustacean the height of a tower block. The first kaiju most worlds ever see.

units.name: Lantern
units.blurb: An anglerfish that learned to walk. Its lure hypnotises anything that looks at it too long.

units.name: Riftback
units.blurb: Its spine still carries a shard of the rift it crawled out of, and the shard still glows.

units.name: Maw
units.blurb: Mostly mouth. The rest of it is there to carry the mouth somewhere new.

units.name: Choir
units.blurb: A cluster of throats that sing in a key your sensors file as an error.

units.name: Deep King
units.blurb: Crowned in coral and wreckage. Smaller Abyssians move out of its way.

units.name: Sovereign
units.blurb: The Mother's chosen. When a Sovereign walks ashore, whole nations evacuate.

units.name: Rift Heart
units.blurb: The living valve that holds a rift open. Break it and the rift seals. Its UPow grows with the rift's depth (rules.json abyss.heartUpow).

units.name: Abyss Mother
units.blurb: The source of every Abyssian, coiled in the deepest rift. Beaten while other rifts stand open, she retreats deeper and comes back stronger.

units.name: Walls
units.blurb: A settlement's own defences. They fight when no unit is there to; their UPow comes from rules.json (walls).
